title: Full Stack Software Engineer - AI Applications
responsibilities: Build and maintain full-stack product features using React and Python.
Develop scalable backend APIs and services using FastAPI.
Build responsive frontend interfaces using React and modern JavaScript.
Design and optimize PostgreSQL data models and queries.
Integrate AI and LLM capabilities into customer-facing application features.
Develop asynchronous background workflows and caching mechanisms.
Deploy and maintain application services on AWS.
Write unit and integration tests for frontend and backend components.
Collaborate with product, design, AI, and engineering teams to deliver features end to end.
description: We are looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build AI-powered SaaS applications. The engineer will work across the React frontend and Python/FastAPI backend while contributing to database design, cloud infrastructure, and AI-powered product capabilities. The ideal candidate is comfortable owning features from API design through frontend implementation and deployment.
